newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Cavallo denies urging early removal of Menem.
newsitem.headline: Cavallo denies urging early removal of Menem.

text.p: Former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo, engaged in a ferocious row with the Peronist government over corruption, denied Monday attacking President Carlos Menem or urging his removal before 1999.

Cavallo said Clarin newspaper, which published an interview with him Sunday, was inaccurate to interpret his words that "if the Argentine economy withstood a change of minister, it can withstand a change of president" as a direct attack on Menem.
